exposure: Group B: Fresh embryo transfer with E2 levels 3000-5000 pg/ml
High estrogen (E2) levels caused by controlled ovarian hyperstimulation
Group A: FET with E2 levels > 5000 pg/ml on trigger day
Group C: FET with E2 levels 3000-5000 pg/ml
cohort: 581 women with singleton pregnancies after ART, including those who had an unwanted abortion under high E2 levels on trigger day.
finding: Fresh embryo transfer under supraphysiological levels of estrogen exposure (E2 levels 3000-5000 pg/ml) may increase the birth defect rate of ART singletons compared to FET.
mod_finding: Fresh embryo transfer may be associated with an increased risk of birth defects compared to frozen embryo transfer.
birth_weight: Recorded, but no significant differences found between groups.
